pick.name: Hono (+ oRPC or Hono RPC for typed clients)
pick.what: Web-standard TS API framework for Node, Bun, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel
pick.why: Same TS types/zod schemas reach web, Expo and Electron clients; runs on any host incl. free edge tiers; streamSSE built in, MCP via the separate @hono/mcp middleware

alts.name: FastAPI
alts.what: Python async API with Pydantic + OpenAPI + SSE
alts.why: Use as a side service when the work needs Python-only AI libs

candidates.name: Hono (pick)
candidates.verdict: Tiny, portable, typed end-to-end; start mounted inside Next route handlers, split out later.

candidates.name: FastAPI
candidates.verdict: Wins for Python AI/data services (Docling, Presidio, pandas).

candidates.name: NestJS
candidates.verdict: Wins for enterprise-style structure; more boilerplate for a solo dev.

candidates.name: Encore.ts (MPL-2.0)
candidates.verdict: Infra-from-code is attractive but small adoption (35k/wk) and pushes Encore Cloud.

candidates.name: Elysia
candidates.verdict: Fast on Bun; last release 2026-08-26, Bun-centric.

candidates.name: Fastify / Express
candidates.verdict: Node-only; Express is legacy-shaped, Fastify fine but not edge-portable.

candidates.name: Django (+Ninja) / Litestar
candidates.verdict: Strong Python choices; Django if you want batteries-included admin.

candidates.name: Next.js route handlers only
candidates.verdict: OK for v0; mobile/desktop clients are better served by a standalone API.

decision: Hono gives one TS backend that runs on Node, Bun or Workers and shares types with all three clients. Keep FastAPI for a separate Python AI worker when a Python-only library is required; switch the main API to FastAPI only if most business logic ends up in Python.
details: Typed API layer: oRPC 1.16 (MIT, OpenAPI output + typed client) preferred for public APIs; tRPC 11.19 for internal; Hono RPC is lightest but slows TS on big route trees.

verify.note: Hono over FastAPI holds for this TS one-stack (shared zod types across Next/Expo/Electron; Vercel AI SDK is the primary agent framework; Python stays a side service for Docling/Presidio). Wording error: MCP is not 'built in' - @hono/mcp is a separate middleware package.
